_readme: S409 SkyOcotillo, 2026-10-17. The archive read (run 39075017243) lists each recent year as a page on canadacollege.edu (2025-26catalog-addendum.php and earlier), and the How to Get page's 'PDF of the Catalog' link goes to addendum.php. This read opens addendum.php and the 2025-2026 page to find where the 2026-2027 catalog PDF sits and on which host. Pages only, no model call, no table write.

questions.catalog_pdf: Whether canadacollege.edu links a 2026-2027 catalog as a PDF, its address and the words on its link, and on which host the file sits.
